series.name: Bitcoin
series.label: Inactive supply ≥ 1 day
series.scope: Bitcoin UTXOs aged at least 1 day. Age runs from creation on the running maximum of block-header timestamps.
series.method: Sum of BTC in unspent outputs at the final indexed block of the calendar month.

series.name: Bitcoin
series.label: Share of inactive supply ≥ 1 day
series.scope: Bitcoin UTXOs aged at least 1 day. Age runs from creation on the running maximum of block-header timestamps.
series.method: 100 × BTC in the selected age bands / BTC in all indexed unspent outputs at month-end. Bitcoin Core excludes provably unspendable outputs such as OP_RETURN.

series.name: Bitcoin
series.label: Previously inactive BTC spent ≥ 1 day
series.scope: Bitcoin UTXOs aged at least 1 day. Age runs from creation on the running maximum of block-header timestamps.
series.method: Month-end difference in cumulative gross spent-output value across the selected age bands. Includes change-related spending, self-transfers and consolidations.

series.name: Bitcoin
series.label: Unspent transaction outputs
series.scope: Bitcoin Core UTXO set, including zero-value outputs.

scopeI18n.it: Insieme degli UTXO Bitcoin Core, inclusi gli output a valore zero.
scopeI18n.fr: Ensemble des UTXO Bitcoin Core, y compris les sorties de valeur nulle.
scopeI18n.de: UTXO-Menge von Bitcoin Core, einschließlich Outputs mit Wert null.

series.method: Stock after the last block in the month. Outputs Core classifies as unspendable are excluded.

methodI18n.it: Conteggio dopo l’ultimo blocco del mese. Esclude gli output che Core classifica come non spendibili.
methodI18n.fr: Effectif après le dernier bloc du mois. Les sorties classées indépensables par Core sont exclues.
methodI18n.de: Bestand nach dem letzten Block des Monats. Von Core als unausgebbar eingestufte Outputs sind ausgeschlossen.

series.name: Bitcoin
series.label: Gross spent-input value
series.scope: Bitcoin spent inputs on the canonical chain. UTC months follow Bitview’s monotonic block time.

scopeI18n.it: Bitcoin, input spesi sulla catena canonica. Mesi UTC secondo il tempo monotono dei blocchi di Bitview.
scopeI18n.fr: Bitcoin, entrées dépensées sur la chaîne canonique. Mois UTC selon le temps monotone des blocs de Bitview.
scopeI18n.de: Bitcoin, ausgegebene Inputs der kanonischen Kette. UTC-Monate nach monotonen Blockzeitstempeln von Bitview.

series.method: Sum of input values in non-coinbase transactions, equal to output value plus fees. Includes change, self-transfers and consolidations. Counted each time BTC is spent. Monthly differences of the cumulative input counter, reported to 0.0001 BTC.

methodI18n.it: Somma dei valori degli input delle transazioni diverse dalla coinbase, pari agli output più le commissioni. Include resto, autotrasferimenti e consolidamenti. I BTC contano ogni volta che vengono spesi. Differenza tra cumulati consecutivi, arrotondata a 0,0001 BTC.
methodI18n.fr: Somme des valeurs des entrées des transactions hors coinbase, égale aux sorties plus les frais. Inclut monnaie rendue, transferts à soi-même et consolidations. Les BTC comptent à chaque dépense. Différence des cumuls entre deux fins de mois, arrondie à 0,0001 BTC.
methodI18n.de: Summe der Inputwerte aller Transaktionen außer Coinbase. Sie entspricht den Outputs zuzüglich Gebühren. Wechselgeld, Überträge an eigene Adressen und Konsolidierungen sind enthalten. BTC zählen bei jeder Ausgabe erneut. Differenz aufeinanderfolgender Monatsendstände, gerundet auf 0,0001 BTC.
